OvenDTMod: Modifies the rate at which the oven heats, cools, and bakes (1.25 for vanilla)
FuelBurnRateMod: Multiplier applied to burn rate of fuels used in oven (1.25 for vanilla)
OvenBakeTimeMod: Additional direct modifier to bake rate (does not affect heating/cooling time (1.2 for vanilla)
MealHealDuration: The amount of time it takes for healing from eating a meal to complete. Default is 180 seconds, or 3 minutes.
MealHealTickCount: The number of ticks that occur while healing from eating a meal. Defaults to 18, i.e. one tick every 10 seconds with the default duration of 180 seconds.
ExpandedFoodHealDuration: The amount of time it takes for healing from eating or drinking to complete. Default is 180 seconds, or 3 minutes.
ExpandedFoodHealTickCount: The number of ticks that occur while healing from eating or drinking. Defaults to 18, i.e. one tick every 10 seconds with the default duration of 180 seconds.
SpileCountPerTree: Allow a certain number of spiles per tree. Set to 0 to disable the restriction entirely.
